gen-gf-revalia-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans reads sturdy and large, with an e whose eye opens clearly, so this sans-serif body never feels cramped. Revalia strides across the top, bold and loosely spaced.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-lexend-peta: Blockletter stands tall in the middle, drawn like pencil that never presses harder. Lexend Peta follows with curves that never thin and a large x-height, and the whole pairing hangs on that unbroken line.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono stands its letters like pins in a board. Bushcraft does the expressive work, spacing characters wide with capitals barely rising, while Cascadia Mono keeps curves and stems matched.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-lexend-giga: Wide, loose and artistic, Bushcraft spaces its letters far apart. Lexend Giga's flat linework and open tracking suit a modest body size, so let the heading take the larger one.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-lexend-mega: Bushcraft never shifts weight along a curve, and its capitals barely stand out. Lexend Mega carries a lengthy text smoothly, its one-nib line and gapped c shapes keeping each word distinct.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa draws curves that stay wide open and distinct, with a thickness that never changes, plus stubby ascenders and descenders. Across a full page of text it moves along quietly and clearly. Capture Smallz plays the raw foil.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga reads spaciously, its generous tracking opening every word beneath the raw, big-bodied Capture Smallz. Line after line it stays smooth and unhurried, ascenders barely clearing the x-height.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-lexend-tera: Raw and chunky up top, Capture Smallz lets Lexend Tera draw its plotter-pen line below. And the real strength is how openly those rounded letters stand apart, like stepping stones.
gen-dafont-cheri-fs-asap: Soft, calligraphic and a bit cute, Cheri has no hairlines at all. Asap meets it with open arcs and a body height close to its capitals, so the two share a steady, friendly line.
